findings.detail: Amazon EKS ended standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2026-12-02; the cluster is in extended support until 2027-12-02, when Amazon EKS stops supporting it. Extended support costs $4,380 more per cluster per year at list price ($0.60 against $0.10 per cluster-hour, over 8,760 hours; list price as of 2026-10-03, not your bill). Extended support is on by default and billed per cluster-hour.
findings.remediation: Upgrade the control plane, one minor at a time. The nearest minor in standard support is 1.35.
findings.title: Kubernetes 1.34 is past Amazon EKS standard support (ended 2026-12-02)
